tour.welcomeBody: A one-minute tour of your console: where alerts arrive, how to act on them, and where to look ahead.
tour.alertsBody: New pollution alerts for your jurisdiction arrive here live, most urgent first. Open one to read the briefing, then move it along: acknowledge, in progress, resolved. Every step is recorded.
tour.hotspotsBody: Every neighbourhood cell is scored for pollution each hour. Red cells need attention; an amber outline marks a hidden hotspot far from any monitor. Tap a cell for its signals and 7-day history.
tour.forecastBody: Air quality for the next 72 hours, with the GRAP stage it implies, so restrictions can start before the peak.
tour.federationBody: Compare trends with other states and adopt models they have shared. Only summaries are shared; citizens' reports never leave your state.
tour.pushTitle: Get alerts even when this tab is closed
tour.pushBody: Turn on alert notifications so a new hotspot reaches you on this device right away.
tour.helpBody: Replay this tour, switch language or theme, and sign out from here.
